{"code": "from math import sqrt

# Compute standard error of the difference in proportions
n_treatment = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment'].shape[0]
n_control = df[df['arm'] == 'control'].shape[0]

p_treatment = df[df['arm'] == 'treatment']['responded'].mean()
p_control = df[df['arm'] == 'control']['responded'].mean()

# Pooled proportion for standard error
p_pooled = (df['responded'].sum()) / (n_treatment + n_control)

# Standard error of the difference in proportions
se_diff = sqrt(p_pooled * (1 - p_pooled) * (1/n_treatment + 1/n_control))

# 95% confidence interval
z = 1.96  # 95% z-value
lower_ci = treatment_effect - z * se_diff
upper_ci = treatment_effect + z * se_diff

se_diff, lower_ci, upper_ci"}
